span.p:
All edges shown are built.
Order events are per-outcome (TD-15); order-service learns authorize synchronously, not from PaymentAuthorized.
inventory-service publishes nothing (inventory-events has no event types) but consumes OrderCancelled to release reservations.
OrderCancelled is US-9's shared fan-out: payment void, inventory release, fulfilment abort, notification copy.
Dispatch outcomes stay on fulfilment-events and are not mirrored into order-events.
catalog-service and cart-service publish nothing and are omitted.
